query: SELECT f.name, fs.transactionType, fs.minValue, fs.maxValue, fs.antiMoneyLaunderingFee FROM firm_fee_structures fs JOIN law_firms f ON f.id = fs.firmId WHERE fs.antiMoneyLaunderingFee != 49.00 ORDER BY f.name, fs.transactionType, fs.minValue;
